Reorder library folders

PUT/api/v1/folders/org/{org_id}/order
Token de APIfolders:updateou sessão de usuário

Persist the manual (admin drag) ordering of sibling folders. Reorders root folders by default; pass `parent_folder_uuid` to reorder a folder's direct sub-folders. Admin only.

Parâmetros de caminho

org_idintegerrequired

Parâmetros de query

parent_folder_uuidstring | null

Corpo da requisiçãoapplication/jsonobrigatório

folder_order_by_idsFolderOrder[]required
Show child attributes
folder_idintegerrequired
Respostas de erro
  • 400 A folder id is not in the org/parent scope
  • 401 Not authenticated
  • 403 Caller is not an organization administrator
  • 404 Organization or parent folder not found
  • 422 Validation Error — HTTPValidationError
Requisição
Resposta
{
  "detail": [
    {
      "loc": [
        "string"
      ],
      "msg": "string",
      "type": "string",
      "input": null,
      "ctx": {}
    }
  ]
}
